defect_taxonomy_and_containment.name: High-Voltage Insulation Resistance Fault (<500 V/Ω)
defect_taxonomy_and_containment.containment: Quarantine vehicle in HV containment bay; re-verify Class-0 gloves; inspect harness for chafing.
defect_taxonomy_and_containment.threshold: Zero tolerance: immediate master technician intervention

defect_taxonomy_and_containment.name: Spot Weld Nugget Separation (<0.12mm penetration)
defect_taxonomy_and_containment.containment: Adjust pulse weld current from 1.8kA to 2.1kA; test on sacrificial nickel strip; peel-test verify.

defect_taxonomy_and_containment.name: Battery Cell Voltage Imbalance (>50mV Delta)
defect_taxonomy_and_containment.containment: Route pack to active equalizer cycler; balance to <10mV delta before sealing.
